bio: Fides Mortgages is the brokerage site linked from Nav's footer; it describes a team of 50+ agents and 100+ lender partners, led by CEO Varan K., offering commercial, private, residential and existing-mortgage solutions and recruiting new agents. Nav Uppal does not appear by name on this page. Nav's own DLC page (navmortgages.ca) shows him as Mortgage Agent Level 1 under Dominion Lending Centres Fides Mortgages.
